_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0% of 72 windows producing a ±2+ point move and neither breaker present (UP needs BTC >$66K + CVD >85 + funding <45; DOWN needs VIX <50 + DXY <55 + funding >65), the statistically honest call is to hold position and let the coil resolve.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — both identify the same structural setup, but the analyst demands patience while the narrative leans more constructive on an imminent re-rating.
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC breaks $66,500 with CVD sustained above 85 and funding stays below 45 (UP breaker), or VIX spikes above 75 with gold holding 95+ and DXY breaking below 95 (macro confirmation)
next_move.invalidated_if: BTC loses $61K with funding rising above 60 and exchange reserves dropping below 75 (forced selling cascade toward Panic), or BTC grinds above $68K with MVRV climbing above 35 and retail velocity spiking above 60 (early transition to Hope/Optimism)
